title: outright — cascade

sentences.sentence: an outright victory
sentences.translation: 彻底的胜利

sentences.sentence: an outright ban on the sale of tobacco
sentences.translation: 全面禁止销售烟草

sentences.sentence: Then it’s really no more than a means of transportation, it too loses its luster.
sentences.translation: 然后它就仅仅是一个名符其实的交通工具，失去了它的光彩。

sentences.sentence: College graduates may be losing some of their luster for reasons beyond technology and trade.
sentences.translation: 大学毕业生也许会因为技术和贸易之外的原因失去一些光彩。

sentences.sentence: No one knows for sure when the tide started to turn, or the exact moment when American gold started its slow but seemingly irreversible loss of luster.
sentences.translation: 无人确切知晓这波潮汐的消退始于何时，也没有人精确的得知美金的光泽从何时起开始缓慢，但不可逆转的褪色。

sentences.sentence: wanton growth
sentences.translation: 繁芜的生长

sentences.sentence: Pink tinged her cheeks.
sentences.translation: 她面色粉红。

sentences.sentence: It may be tempting for some to decry incentives as nothing but a poisonous fruit of Con-Lib responsibility thinking.
sentences.translation: 对一些人谴责激励机制只是作为“新政治”责任思考的毒果这样的结论本身是很冒险的。

sentences.sentence: I know ‘tis the season to decry all things materialistic, but just as we’re inspired by people we are also inspired by things.
sentences.translation: 我想这是谴责所有事情物质化的时候了，然而正如我们被人所激励一样，我们也受事物的激励。

sentences.sentence: All of that is grist for the mill for the Russian media, which is popular in the east of the country and uses every opportunity to decry "fascism" in Ukraine.
sentences.translation: 所有这些都像谷物被放进研磨机中一样，被俄国媒体粉碎，后者在这个国家的东部地区广受欢迎，并利用一切机会谴责乌克兰国内的“法西斯主义”。

phrases.translation: 柱焊，嵌柱焊接；螺柱焊接；电栓焊

sentences.sentence: Use a regular stud plus a “trimmer” on each side of the door.
sentences.translation: 使用常规壁骨，然后在门的两边各加一条“装饰边”。

sentences.sentence: traumas such as death or divorce
sentences.translation: 死亡、离婚等的巨大痛苦

sentences.sentence: If your goal is frugality, then consider what things are not necessary, the long-term impact of the choice you make and whether you can afford it.
sentences.translation: 如果你的目标是俭省，那么就考虑什么东西是没必要的，你做出选择后的长期影响以及你是否可以担负得起。

sentences.sentence: I’m doing so to show you that if there’s not a little frugality in you already, there easily could be. Why?
sentences.translation: 我这么做只是为了告诉你们如果到这一刻为止你还未曾尝试过节俭一点的话，那么你是很容易做到的，为什么？

sentences.sentence: So there you have it, a few ways in which we have brought frugality into our lives.
sentences.translation: 就是这么多了，一些方法让我们把节俭带入了我们的生活。

sentences.sentence: arable farming
sentences.translation: 耕作农业

sentences.sentence: arable land (=  land that is suitable for growing crops  )
sentences.translation: 可耕地

sentences.sentence: Who cares about onomatopoeia?
sentences.translation: 谁在意拟声呢？

sentences.sentence: In fact, the word Okobo is an onomatopoeia, that is it represents the sound of walking in them.
sentences.translation: 实际上，欧扣波这个词是个拟声词，象征穿着它走路时发出的声音。

sentences.sentence: He made a further interrogative noise.
sentences.translation: 他发出了进一步疑问的声音。

sentences.sentence: Emergency services seem impotent in the face of such a disaster.
sentences.translation: 面对这种灾难，应急服务机构似乎无能为力。

sentences.sentence: impotent rage
sentences.translation: 于事无补的狂怒

sentences.sentence: It reminds one of sibling rivalry.
sentences.translation: 它让我们想起敌对的兄弟。

sentences.sentence: Concerns about rivalry with HP and IBM may be overdone, he said.
sentences.translation: 他表示,对于与惠普与IBM竞争的忧虑可能过度了.

phrases.translation: 躯体虐待；身体伤害；外观损坏
言语虐待；口头谩骂；说粗话，用污言秽语

sentences.sentence: several cases of child abuse
sentences.translation: 数宗虐待儿童案

sentences.sentence: An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
sentences.translation: 一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

sentences.sentence: The proposals are not new, a number of them have been acted upon in one form or another, others are underway—no university that I know of is oblivious to the revolutions of network and Web.
sentences.translation: 这些提议并不新鲜，其中很多都已经以这样或那样的形式付诸实施过，其他的也正在进行中——据我所知，没有一所大学会忘记网络和网页革命。

sentences.sentence: ...an ever increasing scarcity of water.
sentences.translation: …越来越匮乏的水资源。

sentences.sentence: Police attempts to infiltrate neo-Nazi groups were largely unsuccessful.
sentences.translation: 警方想打入新纳粹团体的行动基本上不成功。

sentences.sentence: The firework went off in a cascade of colour.
sentences.translation: 烟火散开像一片五彩缤纷的瀑布。

sentences.sentence: It should not have a cascade of menus or waterfall of words in which the user will get lost.
sentences.translation: 它不应该有层叠的菜单或瀑布式单词，这样会让用户感到迷惑。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 16 单元

outright
音标：英 /aʊt'raɪt/  美 /'aʊtraɪt/
adj. 彻底的
短语：outright sale — 直销；卖断
例句：an outright victory
彻底的胜利
例句：an outright ban on the sale of tobacco
全面禁止销售烟草

luster
音标：英 /'lʌstɚ/  美 /'lʌstɚ/
n. 光泽
短语：metallic luster — 金属光泽；金属闪光料
短语：pearly luster — 珍珠光泽
短语：bright luster — 镜面光泽
例句：Then it’s really no more than a means of transportation, it too loses its luster.
然后它就仅仅是一个名符其实的交通工具，失去了它的光彩。
例句：College graduates may be losing some of their luster for reasons beyond technology and trade.
大学毕业生也许会因为技术和贸易之外的原因失去一些光彩。
例句：No one knows for sure when the tide started to turn, or the exact moment when American gold started its slow but seemingly irreversible loss of luster.
无人确切知晓这波潮汐的消退始于何时，也没有人精确的得知美金的光泽从何时起开始缓慢，但不可逆转的褪色。

wanton
音标：英 /'wɒntən/  美 /'wɔntən/
adj. 无节制的
例句：wanton growth
繁芜的生长

solicitousness
音标：英 /sə'lisitəsnis/
n. 渴望，殷勤

tinge
音标：英 /tɪn(d)ʒ/  美 /tɪndʒ/
v. 着色，微染色
例句：Pink tinged her cheeks.
她面色粉红。

decry
音标：英 /dɪ'kraɪ/  美 /dɪ'kraɪ/
v. 反对，谴责
例句：It may be tempting for some to decry incentives as nothing but a poisonous fruit of Con-Lib responsibility thinking.
对一些人谴责激励机制只是作为“新政治”责任思考的毒果这样的结论本身是很冒险的。
例句：I know ‘tis the season to decry all things materialistic, but just as we’re inspired by people we are also inspired by things.
我想这是谴责所有事情物质化的时候了，然而正如我们被人所激励一样，我们也受事物的激励。
例句：All of that is grist for the mill for the Russian media, which is popular in the east of the country and uses every opportunity to decry "fascism" in Ukraine.
所有这些都像谷物被放进研磨机中一样，被俄国媒体粉碎，后者在这个国家的东部地区广受欢迎，并利用一切机会谴责乌克兰国内的“法西斯主义”。

stud
音标：英 /stʌd/  美 /stʌd/
v. 用饰钉装饰
短语：stud welding — 柱焊，嵌柱焊接；螺柱焊接；电栓焊
短语：stud bolt — 双头螺栓
例句：Use a regular stud plus a “trimmer” on each side of the door.
使用常规壁骨，然后在门的两边各加一条“装饰边”。

trauma
音标：英 /'trɔːmə/  美 /'traʊmə/
n. 创伤；痛苦的经历
短语：trauma center — 创伤中心；外伤中心
短语：psychic trauma — 精神创伤
短语：emotional trauma — 情绪创伤
短语：trauma surgery — 创伤外科
例句：traumas such as death or divorce
死亡、离婚等的巨大痛苦

frugality
音标：英 /fruː'gælɪtɪ/  美 /frʊ'gæləti/
n. 节俭
例句：If your goal is frugality, then consider what things are not necessary, the long-term impact of the choice you make and whether you can afford it.
如果你的目标是俭省，那么就考虑什么东西是没必要的，你做出选择后的长期影响以及你是否可以担负得起。
例句：I’m doing so to show you that if there’s not a little frugality in you already, there easily could be. Why?
我这么做只是为了告诉你们如果到这一刻为止你还未曾尝试过节俭一点的话，那么你是很容易做到的，为什么？
例句：So there you have it, a few ways in which we have brought frugality into our lives.
就是这么多了，一些方法让我们把节俭带入了我们的生活。

arable
音标：英 /'ærəb(ə)l/  美 /'ærəbl/
adj. 适合耕种的
短语：arable land — 耕地；可耕土地
例句：arable farming
耕作农业
例句：arable land (=  land that is suitable for growing crops  )
可耕地

onomatopoeia
音标：英 /,ɒnə(ʊ)mætə'piːə/  美 /,ɑnə,mætə'piə/
n. 拟声
例句：Who cares about onomatopoeia?
谁在意拟声呢？
例句：In fact, the word Okobo is an onomatopoeia, that is it represents the sound of walking in them.
实际上，欧扣波这个词是个拟声词，象征穿着它走路时发出的声音。

interrogative
音标：英 /,ɪntə'rɒgətɪv/  美 /,ɪntə'rɑɡətɪv/
adj. 提问；质问的
短语：interrogative sentence — 疑问句
短语：interrogative pronoun — 疑问代词
例句：He made a further interrogative noise.
他发出了进一步疑问的声音。

denominator
音标：英 /dɪ'nɒmɪneɪtə/  美 /dɪ'nɑmə'netɚ/
n. 水平，标准
短语：common denominator — [数]公分母

impotent
音标：英 /'ɪmpət(ə)nt/  美 /'ɪmpətənt/
adj. 无力的
例句：Emergency services seem impotent in the face of such a disaster.
面对这种灾难，应急服务机构似乎无能为力。
例句：impotent rage
于事无补的狂怒

rivalry
音标：英 /'raɪv(ə)lrɪ/  美 /'raɪvlri/
n. 对抗
短语：sibling rivalry — 同胞争宠；手足之争
例句：It reminds one of sibling rivalry.
它让我们想起敌对的兄弟。
例句：Concerns about rivalry with HP and IBM may be overdone, he said.
他表示,对于与惠普与IBM竞争的忧虑可能过度了.

abuse
音标：英 /ə'bju:z/  美 /ə'bjus/
v&n. 虐待，谩骂
短语：drug abuse — 药物滥用；毒品滥用
短语：child abuse — 虐待儿童，摧残儿童
短语：substance abuse — 物质滥用；滥用药物
短语：sexual abuse — 性虐待
短语：abuse of power — 滥用权力
短语：alcohol abuse — 酒精滥用，酗酒
短语：physical abuse — 躯体虐待；身体伤害；外观损坏
短语：verbal abuse — 言语虐待；口头谩骂；说粗话，用污言秽语
短语：sex abuse — 性虐待（等于sexual abuse）
短语：emotional abuse — 精神虐待
例句：several cases of child abuse
数宗虐待儿童案
例句：An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

oblivious
音标：英 /ə'blɪvɪəs/  美 /ə'blɪvɪəs/
adj. 遗忘的；忘却的
例句：The proposals are not new, a number of them have been acted upon in one form or another, others are underway—no university that I know of is oblivious to the revolutions of network and Web.
这些提议并不新鲜，其中很多都已经以这样或那样的形式付诸实施过，其他的也正在进行中——据我所知，没有一所大学会忘记网络和网页革命。

scarcity
音标：英 /'skeəsɪtɪ/  美 /'skɛrsəti/
n. 缺乏，不足
短语：water scarcity — 水短缺，水荒
例句：...an ever increasing scarcity of water.
…越来越匮乏的水资源。

infiltrate
音标：英 /'ɪnfɪltreɪt/  美 /ɪn'fɪltret/
v. 渗入，使潜入
例句：Police attempts to infiltrate neo-Nazi groups were largely unsuccessful.
警方想打入新纳粹团体的行动基本上不成功。

cascade
音标：英 /kæs'keɪd/  美 /kæ'sked/
n. 小瀑布
短语：cascade control — 串级控制；[计]级联控制
短语：cascade development — 梯级开发；干显影
短语：cascade system — 串级系统
短语：cascade impactor — 阶式碰撞取样器
例句：The firework went off in a cascade of colour.
烟火散开像一片五彩缤纷的瀑布。
例句：It should not have a cascade of menus or waterfall of words in which the user will get lost.
它不应该有层叠的菜单或瀑布式单词，这样会让用户感到迷惑。
